description: Alterations to the existing single storey rear extension, including the continuation of the existing parapet and the insertion of a flat glass skylight and bi-fold doors, and the replacement of the existing first floor windows with uPVC to match neighbouring properties.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P01(A), P02(A), P03(A), P04(A) and P05(A) [received on 5 June 2019], and EX00, EX01, EX02, EX03, EX04, EX05 and Design and Access Statement [received on 30 April 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
